units.source_text: 且说六条妃子闻知葵姬安产，心中不得平静。

en.t: Now Lady Rokujo heard that Lady Aoi had given birth safely, and her heart could not be at peace.

units.source_text: 她想：“早已病势危笃，何以今又平安无事？”

en.t: She thought, "Her illness had already become critical, so how can she now be safe and unharmed?"

units.source_text: 她历历回思自己的魂灵不知不觉地出游时种种情状，

en.t: She vividly recalled all the circumstances of the time when her own spirit had unknowingly wandered out,

units.source_text: 便觉自己的衣衫熏透了葵姬枕边所焚的芥子香。

en.t: and then felt that her clothes were steeped in the mustard-seed incense burned beside Lady Aoi's pillow.

units.source_text: 她很诧异，便净洗头发，更换衣服，试看是否真有其事。

en.t: She was deeply astonished, so she washed her hair clean, changed her clothes, and tried to see whether it was truly so.

units.source_text: 岂知洗头换衣之后，香气依旧不散！

en.t: But even after washing her hair and changing her clothes, the fragrance still would not fade.

units.source_text: 她想：“此种行径，我自己想起了也觉得荒唐。

en.t: She thought, "Even when I myself think back on such conduct, it seems absurd.

units.source_text: 何况别人闻知，岂有不肆意宣扬？”

en.t: If others were to hear of it, how could they fail to spread it everywhere without restraint?"

units.source_text: 但此事不可告人，只能闷在心中，独自悲叹。

en.t: But this matter could not be told to anyone; she could only keep it buried in her heart and grieve alone.

units.source_text: 她的性情便越发变得乖异了。

en.t: Her temperament therefore became more and more strange and contrary.
